# ContainerUnitExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Unit-qualified overloads of the fluent measurement verbs, so any measurement in a fluent chain can be written in points, inches, centimetres, or millimetres.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Methods

- [`Border`](#border): Sets a uniform border width, in the given unit.
- [`BorderBottom`](#borderbottom): Sets the bottom border width, in the given unit.
- [`BorderHorizontal`](#borderhorizontal): Sets the left and right border widths, in the given unit.
- [`BorderLeft`](#borderleft): Sets the left border width, in the given unit.
- [`BorderRight`](#borderright): Sets the right border width, in the given unit.
- [`BorderTop`](#bordertop): Sets the top border width, in the given unit.
- [`BorderVertical`](#bordervertical): Sets the top and bottom border widths, in the given unit.
- [`CornerRadius`](#cornerradius): Sets the corner radius, in the given unit.
- [`Height`](#height): Sets a fixed height, in the given unit.
- [`Margin`](#margin): Sets the page margin, in the given unit.
- [`Padding`](#padding): Sets uniform padding, in the given unit.

- [`PaddingHorizontal`](#paddinghorizontal): Sets left and right padding, in the given unit.
- [`PaddingLeft`](#paddingleft): Sets left padding, in the given unit.

- [`PaddingTop`](#paddingtop): Sets top padding, in the given unit.
- [`PaddingVertical`](#paddingvertical): Sets top and bottom padding, in the given unit.
